Computes density kernels estimated for positive and unlabeled, and the values of those densities inferred for unlabeled predictions (sorted)

Source: R/kernel_unlabeled.R
kernel_unlabeled.Rd

Computes density kernels estimated for positive and unlabeled, and the values of those densities inferred for unlabeled predictions (sorted)

Usage

kernel_unlabeled(data)

Arguments

data

data frame. Needs to have a .pred_1 column with predictions and a known_offender column with 0 for unlabeled and 1 for positive (offender)

Value

a list with 3 elements: f_yp : inferred densities for positive predictions; f_yu : inferred densities for unlabeled predictions; y_u : vector with the predictions of unlabeled
